metrics.definition: Distinct authenticated actors with at least one request on the day, by actor kind.
metrics.limitations: An actor is an API key (a service, client or device); it is NOT a person. Humans are not instrumented. Only since telemetry started; refused requests from a valid key count.

metrics.definition: Distinct authenticated actors active in the 7 UTC days ending on the as-of day.
metrics.limitations: An actor is an API key (a service, client or device); it is NOT a person. Humans are not instrumented.

metrics.definition: Distinct authenticated actors active in the 30 UTC days ending on the as-of day.
metrics.limitations: An actor is an API key (a service, client or device); it is NOT a person. Humans are not instrumented.

metrics.definition: Active people.
metrics.limitations: No human identity is collected: Community is anonymous and the gateway authenticates keys. Not inferred from downloads or IPs.

metrics.definition: Distinct tenants with at least one authenticated request in 30 days.
metrics.limitations: A tenant is an account, not necessarily a company.

metrics.definition: Actors active on two or more distinct days in 30 days.
metrics.limitations: An actor is an API key (a service, client or device); it is NOT a person. Humans are not instrumented.

metrics.definition: Share of actors first seen on a cohort day that are active exactly 7 days later.
metrics.limitations: Cohorts whose day+7 is not yet a complete UTC day, and the first telemetry day (left-censored: everyone looks new), are excluded. Returns NOT_YET_OBSERVABLE when no cohort qualifies.

metrics.definition: Same as retention_d7 for day+30.
metrics.limitations: As retention_d7.

metrics.definition: Same as retention_d7 for day+90.
metrics.limitations: As retention_d7.

metrics.definition: Share of actors active in the previous calendar month that are also active in the as-of month.
metrics.limitations: The as-of month is partial until it ends, so the figure is a lower bound; needs the previous month to be fully covered by telemetry.

metrics.definition: Tenants active before the last 30 days that had no request in the last 30 days.
metrics.numerator: tenants with earlier activity and none in 30d
metrics.limitations: Silence is not a cancellation: this is inactivity, not a lost customer.

metrics.definition: Tenants active in the last 30 days, silent in the 30 days before, with earlier activity.
metrics.limitations: Needs 60+ days of telemetry to be meaningful.

metrics.definition: Median days from tenant creation to its first authenticated request.
metrics.limitations: Tenants created before telemetry started are excluded.

metrics.definition: Actors with a successful Premium/API operation in 30 days (free during FREE_LAUNCH).
metrics.limitations: premium usage is NOT a paying customer.

metrics.definition: Tenants with a successful Premium/API operation in 30 days.
metrics.limitations: premium usage is NOT a paying customer.

metrics.definition: Premium actors over active actors in 30 days.
metrics.limitations: Null when there are no active actors.

metrics.definition: Tenants with an active paid plan.
metrics.limitations: NOT_APPLICABLE while the commercial mode is FREE_LAUNCH.

metrics.definition: Requests per channel (rest, mcp, download).
metrics.limitations: Telemetry is best-effort and runs after the response: a lost write undercounts. It is not the billing source (usage_events is).

metrics.definition: Share of requests ending 5xx or as a tool error.
metrics.limitations: 4xx are caller mistakes and are reported separately.

metrics.definition: p50/p95/p99 request latency from a fixed histogram.
metrics.limitations: Upper edge of the bucket holding the quantile; shown only with >=100 requests. Measured inside the Worker: excludes network time.

metrics.definition: Metered units consumed.
metrics.limitations: Reconcilable with usage_events; replays are not counted twice.

metrics.definition: Value of the consumption at the example price list.
metrics.limitations: NOT revenue and NOT receivable: during FREE_LAUNCH nothing is billed.

metrics.definition: Amount actually billed.
metrics.limitations: Zero during FREE_LAUNCH.

metrics.definition: Tenants per conversion state.
metrics.limitations: VISITOR is not instrumented (no web analytics without consent). Payment states are NOT_APPLICABLE in FREE_LAUNCH and need verified Stripe data afterwards.

metrics.definition: Observed increase of the cumulative GitHub download counter of bundle assets.
metrics.numerator: sum of deltas between observations of the same asset_id
metrics.limitations: Counts requests GitHub served, not people, devices, countries or completed transfers; history before the first observation is unknown; includes our own and CI downloads.
